Alternative to UACC-Adapter-PoE-USBC to make a G4 Instant PoE? (i.e. avoid $90 in adapters for a $99 camera)
Hi there, I have a couple of G4 instant cameras and I'd like the option of making one of them PoE capable.

I made the mistake of ordering the "POE to USB-C adapter" from Ubiquiti not realizing it was just a $19 (+ shipping + tax) usb-c to usb-c cable.  

It looks like I also need "UACC-Adapter-PoE-USBC" which is another $65 shipped -- basically meaning you need $90 in adapters just to have the option for a $99 camera to be PoE with data.

Are there any alternatives to this?   

P.S.  Here's the cable that's labeled as "PoE to USB-C" but has no PoE capability itself (my older eyes missed the asterick):  [https://store.ui.com/us/en/collections/camera-poe-to-usb-c-cables/products/uacc-g4-ins-cable-usb-4-5m?variant=uacc-g4-ins-cable-usb-45m](https://store.ui.com/us/en/collections/camera-poe-to-usb-c-cables/products/uacc-g4-ins-cable-usb-4-5m?variant=uacc-g4-ins-cable-usb-45m)
